title: Updated Title Without Gemini
originalPrompt: A detective solves a mysterious case.
summary: Detective Vance Sterling investigates the impossible heist of the Midnight Sapphire from a locked manor room, only to find the culprit came from above.

characters.name: Detective Vance Sterling
characters.description: A sharp, observant private eye who notices what everyone else overlooks.
characters.appearance: Mid-30s man, stubbled jaw, sharp amber eyes, tan double-breasted trench coat with popped collar, dark charcoal fedora with a thin crimson band.

characters.name: Arthur Pendelton
characters.description: The manor's nervous, fastidious butler hiding a secret.
characters.appearance: Elderly slender man, slicked silver hair, gold wire-rimmed monocle over left eye, crisp black-and-white butler tuxedo tailcoat.
characters.personality: Fidgety, anxious, overly polite under pressure.

panels.sceneDescription: Vance Sterling inspects a shattered glass pedestal inside a gloomy Victorian study illuminated by lightning.
panels.background: Opulent Victorian manor study with rain-lashed gothic windows, mahogany bookshelves, and lightning flash illuminating a shattered glass display pedestal.
panels.actions: Crouching beside the smashed glass pedestal, examining the empty velvet cushion with a brass magnifying glass.
panels.expression: Focused, brow furrowed in deep concentration.

dialogue.speaker: Detective Vance Sterling
dialogue.text: Locked doors, unbroken seals, yet the Midnight Sapphire vanished.

panels.caption: Rainy midnight at Blackwood Manor.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art style. Mid-shot, dramatic noir lighting. Detective Vance Sterling, mid-30s man with stubble, amber eyes, tan double-breasted trench coat, charcoal fedora with crimson band, crouching by a shattered glass display case on an ornate pedestal in a dark gothic manor study. Lightning flashes through large rain-streaked windows behind him. Deep shadows, dynamic ink lines, high contrast. No text, no speech bubbles.

panels.sceneDescription: Vance shines his flashlight upward toward a high skylight latch, revealing glossy black feathers caught in the brass lock.
panels.background: High vaulted ceiling of the study with a heavy brass skylight slightly ajar, rain drops hitting the glass pane above.
panels.actions: Standing tall, pointing a slender brass flashlight beam directly toward the ceiling skylight latch.
panels.expression: Subtle smirk of realization, sharp eyes widening slightly.

dialogue.speaker: Detective Vance Sterling
dialogue.text: The thief didn't pick the lock. He flew right through it.

panels.caption: A single clue caught in the brass.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art style. Low-angle Dutch tilt shot looking upward. Detective Vance Sterling in tan trench coat and charcoal fedora with red band aims a glowing flashlight beam at an open ceiling skylight. In the light beam, iridescent black raven feathers are trapped in the brass window latch. Bold comic ink hatching, saturated colors, moody atmosphere. No text, no speech bubbles.

panels.sceneDescription: Vance confronts Arthur the butler, who sweats nervously beside an ornate Victorian birdcage covered in velvet cloth.
panels.background: Corner of the dimly lit library study beside a tall grandfather clock and a gilded ornate birdcage stand draped in dark velvet.
panels.actions: Vance steps forward with arms folded, staring down Arthur. Arthur clutches his hands together nervously, sweating profusely.
panels.expression: Vance looks smug and confident; Arthur looks panicked and guilty.

dialogue.speaker: Detective Vance Sterling
dialogue.text: Care to explain what your pet raven has stashed under that cloth, Arthur?

dialogue.speaker: Arthur Pendelton
dialogue.text: M-merely birdseed, sir! I swear it!

panels.caption: Every locked room has a blind spot.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art style. Medium two-shot. On the left, Detective Vance Sterling in his tan trench coat and fedora, looking down sternly. On the right, Arthur Pendelton, elderly butler with slicked silver hair, monocle, and black-and-white tailcoat, sweating nervously beside an ornate draped birdcage. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, expressive comic line art. No text, no speech bubbles.

panels.sceneDescription: Vance lifts the cage cloth to reveal a large intelligent raven perched next to the glowing, cut Midnight Sapphire in its nest.
panels.background: Close view inside the gilded birdcage, surrounded by warm ambient study light.
panels.actions: Vance holds the brilliant blue gem in his leather-gloved hand while a glossy raven tilts its head curiously; Arthur slumps in defeat in the background.
panels.expression: Vance gives a triumphant grin; Arthur holds his head in despair.

dialogue.speaker: Detective Vance Sterling
dialogue.text: Case closed. Looks like your accomplice sang like a canary.

panels.caption: A master thief with wings.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art style. Dynamic close-up hero shot. Detective Vance Sterling holding up a glowing, deep blue Midnight Sapphire in his leather-gloved hand with a victorious grin, wearing his charcoal fedora with crimson band. In the brass birdcage beside his hand, a sleek glossy black raven perches proudly. Defeated butler Arthur Pendelton visible blurred in the background. Rich vibrant comic palette, sharp cel-shaded highlights. No text, no speech bubbles.

title: The Chronic Lagger
originalPrompt: A college student who is always late.
summary: Leo, a perpetually late college student, attempts to make it to his 8 AM exam but finds himself in a series of comedic delays.

characters.name: Leo
characters.description: A disheveled college student who is constantly running behind.
characters.appearance: Messy brown hair, wearing a wrinkled oversized blue hoodie and pajama pants with mismatched socks.

panels.sceneDescription: Leo wakes up in a messy dorm room with his alarm clock blaring 8:15 AM.
panels.background: A cramped, messy dorm room with posters on the walls and clothes on the floor.
panels.actions: Leo jolts upright in bed, eyes wide with horror as he stares at the glowing red clock.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: 8:15? My exam started at 8:00. Goodbye, GPA.

panels.caption: The alarm clock is the only thing Leo consistently beats.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art style. Close-up on Leo with messy brown hair and a wrinkled blue hoodie waking up in bed. Red glowing alarm clock showing 8:15. Background is a cluttered dorm room. Dynamic lighting, high contrast, frantic mood.

panels.sceneDescription: Leo sprinting down the hallway of the dorm building.
panels.background: Dimly lit, narrow concrete university hallway.
panels.actions: Leo is running full speed, clutching his textbooks, one pajama pant leg is rolled up, the other is down.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I can still make it if I run!

panels.caption: Sprint mode: Activated.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art style. Wide shot of Leo in his blue hoodie and pajama pants running frantically through a university hallway. Motion lines. High energy, fast-paced action.

panels.sceneDescription: Leo reaches the heavy oak door of the lecture hall, but it's locked.
panels.background: A large, imposing wooden door with a frosted glass window labeled 'FINAL EXAM IN PROGRESS'.
panels.actions: Leo is slumped against the door, panting heavily, sweat dripping from his forehead.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Please, just let it be a 3-hour exam...

panels.caption: The final hurdle.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art style. Medium shot of Leo leaning against a large oak door with a sign. Leo looks tired, disheveled blue hoodie, messy hair. Dim hallway lighting.

panels.sceneDescription: Leo looks at his phone and realizes the date.
panels.background: Outside the lecture hall door, in the hallway.
panels.actions: Leo stares at his smartphone screen, his face dropping in realization.
panels.caption: There is always tomorrow... maybe.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art style. Close-up on Leo's face as he stares at his phone screen. His expression shifts from panic to utter confusion. The blue hoodie is visible. Clear, bright lighting.

title: The Late Student
originalPrompt: A college student who is always late to class tries to sneak in unnoticed.
summary: Arun oversleeps after an intense coding sprint, dashes across campus in chaotic hurry, and attempts a stealth entry into Professor Sharma's Advanced Algorithms lecture.

characters.name: Arun
characters.description: Undergraduate CSE student who stays up coding till 4 AM
characters.appearance: Messy black hair, askew glasses, oversized yellow hoodie with blue jeans, unzipped backpack

characters.name: Professor Sharma
characters.description: Veteran Computer Science Professor with eagle eyes
characters.appearance: Neat graying mustache, tweed jacket with elbow patches, clipboard, strict silver spectacles

panels.sceneDescription: Arun in dorm room jolting awake as alarm clock rings violently at 8:54 AM for a 9:00 AM exam.
panels.background: Messy college dorm with code editor glowing on monitor, textbooks piled high
panels.actions: Falling out of bed entangled in blanket, wide eyes staring at clock

dialogue.speaker: Arun
dialogue.text: 8:54?! SIX MINUTES TO SPRINT A MILE AND PASS ALGORITHMS?!

panels.caption: T-minus six minutes to academic oblivion.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art style. A frantic college student with messy black hair and askew glasses jolts out of bed in shock, tangled in blankets, staring at an alarm clock flashing 8:54 AM. Vibrant dramatic comic shadows and speedlines.

panels.sceneDescription: Arun sprinting at breakneck speed down the college hallway with shoes half on.
panels.background: Brick college campus corridor with blurred posters and passing students
panels.actions: Spriting with toast hanging out of mouth, papers flying out of bag

dialogue.speaker: Arun
dialogue.text: If I can sprint at 25 km/h, I might only be 6 minutes late!

panels.caption: Target: Lecture Hall 302
panels.imagePrompt: Comic book art. Young college student in bright yellow hoodie sprinting desperately down a college corridor, toast in mouth, flying notebook pages, dynamic motion blur and comic dust clouds.

panels.sceneDescription: Arun arrives outside Lecture Hall 302 door. He peeks through the narrow door window.
panels.background: Wooden lecture hall door with polished brass handle and warning sign
panels.actions: Crouching low, one eye peeking through window glass

dialogue.speaker: Arun
dialogue.text: If Professor Sharma is facing the blackboard, I can crawl to row four unseen...

panels.caption: Hall 302: Silence inside
panels.imagePrompt: Comic panel. A college student sneaking outside a classroom door, peering through the small rectangular glass window with intense caution. Dramatic side lighting, comic suspense shadows.

panels.sceneDescription: Arun pushes the door open by 2 inches, only for the rusty hinges to emit an ear-splitting creak.
panels.background: Close up on metallic brass hinge with sound wave reverberations
panels.actions: Freezing mid-motion with foot suspended in air

dialogue.speaker: Arun
dialogue.text: Did someone lubricate these hinges with pure gravel?!

panels.caption: The loudest noise in human history.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic panel with giant sound effect SCREEECH blasting from a metal door hinge. Shocked student with foot frozen in mid air, pupils contracted with horror. Comic explosion graphics.

panels.sceneDescription: Inside classroom. The entire lecture hall has turned around. Professor Sharma stands with arms crossed.
panels.background: Steep tiered lecture hall filled with 80 students staring directly at Arun
panels.actions: Professor Sharma lowering glasses on his nose, holding attendance register

dialogue.speaker: Professor Sharma
dialogue.text: Ah, Mr. Arun! Thank you for gracing us with your presence. We were just calculating the time complexity of waking up on time.

panels.caption: 80 pairs of eyes lock on.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic scene inside college lecture hall. Strict professor with spectacles lowered on nose, arms crossed, staring directly at the tardy student. Rows of smiling and smirking classmates looking back.

panels.sceneDescription: Arun sitting at the very front row center desk, right under the professor nose, sheepishly opening notebook.
panels.background: Front row desk right in front of blackboard covered in quiz problems
panels.actions: Arun smiling nervously with pen ready, Professor tapping desk with chalk

dialogue.speaker: Arun
dialogue.text: On the bright side, best seat in the house for the quiz!

dialogue.speaker: Professor Sharma
dialogue.text: Ten points deducted for door squeak decibels, Arun.

panels.caption: Never late... just fashionably penalized.
panels.imagePrompt: Comic finale panel. College student sitting sheepishly in front row with sweatdrop on forehead, smiling awkwardly while the professor taps a piece of chalk on his desk. Humorous comic conclusion.
